title: Weighted decoupling with lower-dimensional frequency localization
summary: We prove weighted $L^2$ and refined $L^p$ decoupling estimates for functions whose Fourier transforms are supported in a small neighborhood of the unit sphere or the truncated paraboloid with an additional lower-dimensional frequency localization property. As a special case, we recover the fractal $L^2$ restriction estimate of Du and Zhang, with a sharper dependence on the density of the weight.
